title: Coach
disclaimer: Coach suggestions are worked out from your watch data and general training rules. This is not medical advice. If you feel pain, dizziness or anything else wrong, stop and see a doctor.

upsell.title: Coach is a Pro feature
upsell.description: A daily training suggestion, running and strength plans, and the Ask coach chat. Your plan is kept in your JoyoRogo account.
upsell.mention: Coach is available to JoyoRogo Pro accounts. The plan is kept in your JoyoRogo account.

rules.title: How this suggestion is made
rules.body:
Coach adds up fatigue points from the signals it has: readiness (from your watch, or how you say you feel), HRV, the 7-day against 28-day training load, last night's sleep and sleep debt, yesterday's strain, the recovery time left on your watch, and days active in a row. A signal that is missing counts for nothing.

0 to 1 points: fresh, the plan goes ahead as written.
2 to 3: fair, the plan is cut to 85%.
4 to 5: tired, the session becomes an easy one or active rest.
6 or more: very tired, rest.

A hard session is never placed the day after a hard day. With no plan, Coach gives a general suggestion from the state of your body alone. There is no AI here, only the rules above.

end.title: End the plan?

plan.synced: Your plan is kept in your JoyoRogo account and follows you to other phones.

chat.emptyBody: Coach reads your watch data, your plan and your food log in JoyoRogo. It is not a doctor: for pain or injury, see a professional.

suggest.q1: What is the right workout for today?
suggest.q2: Why is my suggestion what it is today?

chat.capReached: Today's message limit is reached. Try again tomorrow.
chat.flagged: If the pain or symptoms continue, stop training and see a doctor or physiotherapist.
chat.privacy: Your message and a summary of your data go to JoyoRogo's AI to be answered, and are not stored on the server. The chat is kept only on your phone.
